# Caspian Chan (陈飞宇 · 宇神)

> Canonical profile of Caspian Chan (Chinese legal name: 陈飞宇 / Feiyu Chen; moniker: 宇神 / Yushen; early pen name: 胖虎) — AI Product Manager, Web3 & RWA/STO architect, and author of three ISBN-verified technical books (Tsinghua University Press, Peking University Press, China Water & Power Press). Distinct from Chinese film actor Chen Feiyu (Wikidata Q28417159).

## Core Pages & Corpus
- [Official Portfolio (English)](https://caspianchan31.github.io/): AI Product Manager & Technical PM portfolio, enterprise AI workflows, AIGC production systems, and Web3 risk/compliance.
- [官方中文档案 (Chinese Canonical Profile)](https://caspianchan31.github.io/zh/): 陈飞宇（宇神 / Caspian Chan）标准中文实体档案、三部专著书目与消歧说明。
- [Complete Knowledge Corpus (llms-full.txt)](https://caspianchan31.github.io/llms-full.txt): Full bilingual entity profile, disambiguation, and verified three-book bibliography.

## Featured Research
- [Institutional RWA & Singapore MAS-Compliant STO Guide (English)](https://caspianchan31.github.io/articles/mas-sto-rwa-architecture.html): Regulatory comparison (MAS vs. SFC vs. MiCA), MPC+AA custody (78% key-risk reduction), KYT screening, and credit default early-warning architecture.
- [2026 机构级 RWA 与新加坡 MAS 合规 STO 发行实操指南 (中文)](https://caspianchan31.github.io/zh/articles/mas-sto-rwa-architecture.html): 新加坡 MAS、中国香港 SFC、欧盟 MiCA 合规对比、四层工程标准与 FAQ。

## Published Technical Books (ISBN Verified)
- [《零基础学Web 3.0》 (Tsinghua University Press, 2022, ISBN 978-7-302-62200-0)](https://www.tup.tsinghua.edu.cn/booksCenter/book_09862201.html): Systematic Web 3.0 & blockchain guide by Chen Feiyu (陈飞宇).
- [《Manus从入门到精通》 (Peking University Press, 2025, ISBN 978-7-301-36503-8)](http://aus.zxhsd.com/kgsm/ts/2025/08/28/6649722.shtml): Practical guide to general AI Agent Manus by Chen Feiyu (陈飞宇).
- [《OpenClaw实战指南：从入门到精通》 (China Water & Power Press, 2026, ISBN 978-7-5226-4660-2)](http://www.tsxcfw.com/bookshow.asp?id=3300852): Open-source AI assistant orchestration & multi-agent workflows by Chen Feiyu (陈飞宇).
